name: Royal Progress Bar for WooCommerce
author: EsLaM Hamed

sections.description:
Royal Progress Bar for WooCommerce displays a beautiful glassmorphism progress bar across your store to encourage customers to add more items to their cart and unlock free shipping.

Key Features

  • Auto-Detect Threshold — Automatically reads your WooCommerce shipping zones to find the free shipping minimum.
  • Manual Threshold — Set any custom amount as the free shipping goal.
  • Customizable Colors — Choose gradient start and end colors to match your brand.
  • Multiple Placements — Automatically displays on the Product page, Cart page, and Checkout page.
  • WooCommerce Blocks Support — Compatible with the new block-based Cart and Checkout.
  • Real-Time Updates — Progress bar animates when cart contents change.
  • Toast Notifications — Celebrates when the customer reaches the free shipping goal.
  • Lightweight — No bloat, no unnecessary features. Just a fast, clean progress bar.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the .zip file via the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Free Shipping Bar to configure threshold and colors.
sections.faq:
Does it auto-detect my free shipping threshold?

Yes. When “Auto-detect” is enabled, the plugin reads your WooCommerce shipping zones to find the free shipping minimum amount automatically.

Can I set a manual threshold?

Yes. Disable auto-detect and enter any amount you want as the free shipping goal.

Where does the progress bar appear?

The bar appears automatically on three pages:
1. Product Page — Above the Add to Cart button.
2. Cart Page — Inside the cart summary, before the total.
3. Checkout Page — Inside the order summary, before the total.

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with the block-based Cart and Checkout pages.

Can I customize the bar colors?

Yes. You can set custom gradient start and end colors from the settings page.
